/intro/#4/text: Boss, Boss! You gotta hear this!
/intro/#17/text: I'm home. The wind was kind.
/intro/#18/text: Home safe. Shall I tell you a tale?
/rare/#0/text: Look! It's all sparkly! Did great today, right?
/rare/#1/text: Jackpot! A rare one! My hands are shaking!
/rare/#2/text: Don't faint… Ta-da! A rare find, Boss!
/rare/#3/text: Lucky streak! Never seen one of these!
/rare/#4/text: My pocket's glowing! It's the real deal!
/rare/#5/text: Today's top looter: me! Shiny get!
/rare/#6/text: Treasure just lying on the road? Grabbed it!
/rare/#7/text: Sell this and we're rich, right? Right?
/rare/#8/text: Found a shiny! My heart's going boom-boom!
/rare/#9/text: Lucky day, Boss! This is the good stuff, right?
/rare/#11/text: Picked up a shiny. Got lucky.
/rare/#12/text: Got a rare one. Skip the praise.
/rare/#15/text: Heh, now this is a rare one.
/rare/#16/text: Heh, a real catch for once. Use it wisely.
/rare/#17/text: Didn't expect to find this. Lucky.
/rare/#19/text: Got a shiny. Don't tell the kids.
/rare/#21/text: Look~ Sparkly! Sera's got taste, huh?
/rare/#23/text: Finding these takes skill! Praise me!
/rare/#26/text: Grain like this? Once a lifetime. Hands shaking.
/rare/#27/text: Heh, sharp eye, eh? Can't fool a miner.
/rare/#28/text: Melt this, get good stuff. Promise.
/rare/#29/text: Drinks on me tonight. Found a rare one.
/rare/#30/text: I found something rare. Like a fallen star.
/rare/#31/text: The forest gave a gift today.
/rare/#32/text: Look at this glow. I almost hear an old song.
/rare/#33/text: The wind led me to it. Look.
/rare/#34/text: Shiny things always wait so quietly.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#0/text: A boar treed me for half a day… It's true!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#1/text: {monster} got my butt… I can't even sit!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#2/text: Big Squirrel pelted me with acorns! Ow, a bump!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#3/text: Was Back Hill always this scary? My legs are jelly…
/regions/back_hill/tough/#4/text: Dodged {monster}, fell in the creek! Soaked!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#5/text: Got lost, passed the same tree 3 times… sob
/regions/back_hill/tough/#6/text: Poked a beehive. See my puffy face?
/regions/back_hill/tough/#8/text: I faced the boar head-on! …The boar won!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#9/text: A hundred bee stings! No, a thousand!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#10/text: Rolled down the hill! Kept the stuff, though!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#12/text: Got stung a few times. No big deal.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#13/text: Went around {monster}. Legs hurt. Stomach too.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#14/text: Poked a beehive. Face is puffy.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#15/text: Dodged a boar, fell in the creek. Drying.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#16/text: Hill got steeper? My knees noticed first.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#17/text: {monster} landed one. That's age for you.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#18/text: Heh, a stroll? More like a climb.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#19/text: Slippery path. Nearly fell. Keep it quiet.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#21/text: Why's Back Hill so rough? My hair's ruined!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#22/text: {monster} chased me! Sera's legs are jelly~
/regions/back_hill/tough/#23/text: Mud splash! These boots were new!
/regions/back_hill/tough/#25/text: Ugh, {monster}! Still got the stuff, though.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#26/text: Hills aren't fair to short legs. Hmph.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#27/text: {monster} kept going for my ankles. Coward.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#29/text: Winded. A beer would fix it.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#30/text: Lamp's useless in a meadow. Tch.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#31/text: The hill wind was fierce. My hair's all tangled.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#32/text: {monster} was stubborn. I'm a little tired.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#33/text: The grass hid the path. I wandered a while.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#34/text: Dew soaked my bowstring. My arrows kept missing.
/regions/back_hill/tough/#35/text: The hill kept its heart closed today.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#0/text: Met {monster}, but I tiptoed past, Boss!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#1/text: Got a splinter chopping. Got lots of wood, though!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#3/text: Mistook Iron Ore for a pebble! Hehe!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#4/text: Had a staring contest with {monster}. I won!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#5/text: Ate wild berries, so I'm late. Shh!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#6/text: Hauled logs back. My shoulders ache~
/regions/back_hill/normal/#7/text: Perfect weather on the hill! Fresh air!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#8/text: Conquered Back Hill! Should've planted a flag!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#14/text: Chopped some wood. Got a splinter.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#19/text: Heh, birds were singing. I joined in. Don't ask about pitch.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#23/text: Hair in the wind, one lap~ Total cover shot!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#25/text: Broke a light sweat. A cute one!
/regions/back_hill/normal/#26/text: Did Back Hill. Picked up some rocks.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#28/text: Hm. Lots of trees, no ore.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#29/text: A stroll. Grass in my beard.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#33/text: The wind carried the scent of trees. A good day.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#34/text: A plain path, but clear skies.
/regions/back_hill/normal/#35/text: I found a little hidden trail.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#0/text: Back Hill's a stroll now! Hummed all the way~
/regions/back_hill/easy/#3/text: Too easy, Boss! Somewhere tougher! …Not too tough.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#4/text: {monster} even showed me the way! Haha!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#6/text: Stuff just rolled my way~ Lucky, huh?
/regions/back_hill/easy/#7/text: Sang with the birds all the way. La-la~
/regions/back_hill/easy/#8/text: Beat Back Hill with one hand! Haha!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#10/text: I was so fast the wind couldn't keep up!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#12/text: {monster}? Didn't see it. Oh, maybe I did.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#14/text: Back Hill's a stroll. Even napped.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#16/text: Back Hill? Did it eyes closed. Literally.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#17/text: {monster} stepped aside for me. Polite fellow.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#18/text: Heh, a stroll, not a quest. My knees approve.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#19/text: Heh, an acorn fell. Caught it. Ate it.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#21/text: Back Hill? Done in one wink~
/regions/back_hill/easy/#22/text: {monster} fell for me. Followed me around!
/regions/back_hill/easy/#23/text: Picked flowers on my walk. Want one?
/regions/back_hill/easy/#31/text: I followed a butterfly, and here I am.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#33/text: I wove a crown of wildflowers. For you?
/regions/back_hill/easy/#34/text: The wind showed me the way.
/regions/back_hill/easy/#35/text: My steps were light as a feather.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#0/text: Bats got tangled in my hair! Never again… wait, I have to?
/regions/old_mine/tough/#1/text: Baby Rock Golem rolled at me! Nearly squished!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#2/text: Pitch dark AND {monster}! Torch died, I crawled out…
/regions/old_mine/tough/#3/text: Slipped on a Mine Slime. I'm all sticky!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#4/text: Rocks rained down! Nearly cracked my head!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#5/text: {monster} chased me into a dead end… Waah!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#6/text: Heard the tunnel creak. My heart dropped!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#7/text: I heard a mine ghost… I swear it's true!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#9/text: {monster} was as big as a house! No, a mountain!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#10/text: Ate a bucket of coal dust! Tastes awful, really!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#13/text: Ceiling nearly caved. Eh, I'm alive.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#15/text: Baby golem rolled at me. Dodging's tiring.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#16/text: Deeper than I thought. Torch barely lasted.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#19/text: Bats in my beard. Need a comb.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#20/text: Heh, swallowed a bowl of dust. Can't stop coughing.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#21/text: The Old Mine's so dark! Bat in my hair!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#22/text: {monster} made my clothes all sticky… ugh.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#24/text: Rocks fell! Sera nearly got squished!
/regions/old_mine/tough/#27/text: A pack of {monster} blocking the vein.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#28/text: Deep down, air's heavy. Lamp flickered.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#29/text: Old pick marks. Places get abandoned for a reason.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#31/text: Underground is stifling… I missed the sky.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#32/text: {monster} burst from the dark! My heart nearly stopped.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#33/text: Too cramped to draw my bow. Such trouble.
/regions/old_mine/tough/#34/text: My hair is covered in dust.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#1/text: So hot in the mine! Sweat poured like rain!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#2/text: 100 pick swings! My arms are dying~
/regions/old_mine/normal/#3/text: The echoes scared me, but I acted brave!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#4/text: Rode a cart all the way down. So fun!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#5/text: {monster} kept bugging me, so bonk! Hehe, no problem!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#6/text: Just one torch. My eyes are blurry~
/regions/old_mine/normal/#7/text: Mining coal blackened my nose. Don't laugh!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#8/text: Swung my pickaxe till sparks flew!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#10/text: Went to the mine's end! Probably!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#19/text: Heh, now I know why miners sing. Boredom.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#20/text: Ate some coal dust. Good for digestion.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#21/text: Mine explored~ Even the bats fell for Sera!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#23/text: Coal dust on me. Gotta redo my makeup~
/regions/old_mine/normal/#24/text: Zoomed down in a cart~ So fun!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#25/text: Saw sparkly Silver in there. So pretty!
/regions/old_mine/normal/#28/text: Hm. Ore like this is easy.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#29/text: Tunnels are my home. Never get lost.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#30/text: Fine Iron Ore. Use it well.
/regions/old_mine/normal/#31/text: The mine was still. Do stones dream?
/regions/old_mine/normal/#34/text: Even in the dark, the bats showed me the way.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#0/text: Mine Slime? One hit! The heavy haul was the hardest part!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#1/text: {monster} stepped aside! Am I famous now?
/regions/old_mine/easy/#2/text: Memorized the whole mine! Could go blindfolded!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#3/text: Made friends with the bats. Kidding, haha!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#5/text: Iron Ore piled on the floor! Just scooped it~
/regions/old_mine/easy/#6/text: Old Mine's a stroll! Send me again, Boss!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#7/text: My bag's about to burst. Dug too much?
/regions/old_mine/easy/#8/text: I'm the King of the Old Mine! Ahem!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#10/text: So much loot, carrying it nearly killed me!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#14/text: Slimes are one hit. Just annoying.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#16/text: Heh, the Old Mine? Knees didn't even ache.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#17/text: {monster}? Ran at the sight of my armor.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#18/text: Know every path. No map needed.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#19/text: Heh, just watched the slimes slip around.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#22/text: {monster} stepped aside! Of course, it's Sera!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#23/text: I see fine without a torch. Great eyes!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#25/text: Too easy, so boring. Praise me!
/regions/old_mine/easy/#26/text: Heh. This is my front yard.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#31/text: Even the dark was kind today.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#33/text: An easy trip. Though the ore was heavy.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#34/text: Tiny flowers bloom in the mine.
/regions/old_mine/easy/#35/text: A quiet road. Even the stones slept.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#0/text: Three Goblin Scouts! I tiptoed away. Keep it secret…
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#1/text: Stuck in a giant web, barely escaped! Eek!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#3/text: {monster} spotted me! I nearly died, really!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#4/text: Fell in a goblin trap! Ripped my pants…
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#5/text: Hid from {monster} in a bush. Couldn't breathe!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#6/text: Goblin drums all night… Zero sleep!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#7/text: Lost in the woods, circling till sunset!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#8/text: A hundred goblins chased me! Or fifty?
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#10/text: Got lost and almost cried… I didn't cry!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#11/text: Lots of goblins. Two of us next time.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#13/text: Muddy woods. Rough. I need a bath.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#14/text: Got caught in a web. Still sticky.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#16/text: Goblins swarmed me. My back won't forgive me.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#17/text: Hid from {monster} a while. Tactical retreat.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#19/text: Inhaled spores. World spun a bit.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#20/text: Heh, beard caught in a web. Don't laugh.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#21/text: Too many goblins! Sera was sweating~
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#23/text: Toadstool stink! My head's still spinning~
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#24/text: Got stuck in a web. Sticky, yuck!
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#27/text: Kept tripping on roots. Beard too.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#32/text: I dodged three goblin traps. So close.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#33/text: The trees barred my way… The forest tested me.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#34/text: The forest didn't welcome me. Thorns everywhere.
/regions/goblin_forest/tough/#35/text: I nearly ran out of arrows.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#0/text: Had a showdown with {monster}! So close~
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#1/text: The woods were so deep! Found my way by the moss!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#3/text: Cut my hand skinning. Blow on it, please!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#4/text: Snuck past {monster}! Held my breath so long~
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#5/text: Manastone glinting in the bushes! Eagle-eyed me!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#6/text: Dodging webs made me a limbo pro. Hehe!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#7/text: Woods smell nice. Didn't eat mushrooms, really!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#8/text: Won a goblin staring contest! Scary!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#9/text: Shook off {monster} like a pro! Applause!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#10/text: Went deep into the woods! Brave, huh?
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#15/text: Deep woods. Followed the moss back.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#18/text: Loud goblin drums. Good rhythm, though.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#20/text: Heh, a goblin eyed my axe. Not a chance.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#23/text: Danced to the goblin drums. Kidding~
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#24/text: I smell like leather. Our secret!
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#28/text: Lots of trees, no ore. Hmph.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#30/text: Swiped a goblin cooking pot. Heh.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#31/text: The forest was singing. It felt lovely.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#32/text: I slipped past {monster} through the treetops.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#33/text: The forest always smells like home.
/regions/goblin_forest/normal/#35/text: I led a lost fawn back home.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#0/text: The goblins hid from me! Word's out, Boss!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#2/text: Forest walk! Manastone on the path!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#3/text: Giant Spider saw my sword and fled up its web! Ha!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#4/text: {monster} blocked the path, so I asked nicely~
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#5/text: Goblin Woods is like my own front yard!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#6/text: Leather and Manastone! Good sales today?
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#7/text: It was so comfy I almost feel sorry~
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#9/text: {monster} asked for my autograph! Hehe, kidding!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#10/text: Brought back an armful of Manastone! Well?
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#16/text: Heh, the goblin brats called me Grandpa.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#18/text: Lap of the woods. No sweat.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#19/text: Heh, a Goblin Scout even showed me the way.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#21/text: The goblins started a Sera fan club~
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#23/text: Woods are my playground. Tree climbing!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#25/text: Done so fast I braided my hair!
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#26/text: Goblin stew on the boil. Had a spoonful.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#31/text: I can't get lost in a forest. It's home.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#34/text: Came and went like the wind.
/regions/goblin_forest/easy/#35/text: The forest is quiet… a good omen.
/regions/volcano/tough/#2/text: Armor's an oven by the lava. Nearly cooked.
/regions/volcano/tough/#3/text: Heh, my boot soles melted. Make me new ones.
/regions/volcano/tough/#5/text: The volcano's so hot! My hair went all frizzy!
/regions/volcano/tough/#7/text: Boot heels melted. Buy new ones!
/regions/volcano/tough/#10/text: The volcano? My shoe soles melted… sob
/regions/volcano/tough/#11/text: {monster} breathed fire and burned my bangs!
/regions/volcano/tough/#12/text: So hot I nearly passed out!
/regions/volcano/tough/#13/text: Saw lava, legs went wobbly… It's true!
/regions/volcano/tough/#14/text: {monster} chased me! Sweat pouring like rain!
/regions/volcano/tough/#17/text: Boot soles melted. Need new ones.
/regions/volcano/tough/#18/text: Too hot. Perfect for grilling meat, though.
/regions/volcano/tough/#22/text: Hm. Lava's hotter than a forge.
/regions/volcano/tough/#25/text: Fire is the forest's foe… scary.
/regions/volcano/tough/#26/text: {monster}'s heat singed the hem of my cloak.
/regions/volcano/tough/#27/text: Scorching wind stole my breath. I miss cool springs.
/regions/volcano/tough/#29/text: The lava's roar lingers in my ears.
/regions/volcano/normal/#3/text: Heh, worked in the heat. Now I get your job.
/regions/volcano/normal/#5/text: Back from Volcano Cave! Sera's on fire~
/regions/volcano/normal/#8/text: Lava show was awesome! Like fireworks~
/regions/volcano/normal/#9/text: Nicely hot. Like a sauna, kinda?
/regions/volcano/normal/#11/text: Fought {monster}! Butt's a bit toasty, but I won!
/regions/volcano/normal/#13/text: Fried an egg by the lava. Just kidding!
/regions/volcano/normal/#14/text: Hot, but no sweat! …Can I get some water?
/regions/volcano/normal/#20/text: Did the volcano. Just like a forge.
/regions/volcano/normal/#25/text: Hot, yes, but it glowed like a sunset.
/regions/volcano/normal/#28/text: Firestone glowed like a captured sunset.
/regions/volcano/normal/#29/text: My cheeks went pink. Blame the lava.
/regions/volcano/easy/#0/text: The volcano? Felt like a sauna.
/regions/volcano/easy/#1/text: {monster} tucked its tail. Its flaming tail.
/regions/volcano/easy/#2/text: Roasted sweet potatoes over lava. Tasty.
/regions/volcano/easy/#3/text: Heh, that heat's weaker than my nagging.
/regions/volcano/easy/#5/text: Volcano? Perfect temp for Sera's skin~
/regions/volcano/easy/#6/text: {monster} froze at me. In a volcano!
/regions/volcano/easy/#8/text: Hop over lava! Quick Feet power~
/regions/volcano/easy/#10/text: The volcano? Basically a sauna! Hehe!
/regions/volcano/easy/#13/text: Hopped over the lava! Pretty cool, huh?
/regions/volcano/easy/#14/text: Volcanoes? Just a stroll now! Hehe!
/regions/volcano/easy/#22/text: Not a drop of sweat. Beard's intact.
/regions/volcano/easy/#24/text: Hm. Easy trip. Somewhere hotter next.
/regions/volcano/easy/#25/text: The volcano seemed fast asleep today.
/regions/volcano/easy/#27/text: The wind led me through the lava.
/regions/volcano/easy/#28/text: Back without a single ember on me.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#0/text: Dragon's Nest… no place at my age.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#1/text: {monster} chased me. First run in years.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#2/text: Dragon snoring. Nearly jumped out of my skin.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#3/text: Heh, made it back alive. Half a win.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#4/text: Barely got a few scales. Legs shaking.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#5/text: The Nest is cheating! Even Sera got scared~
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#6/text: Fled {monster} and set a record. A sprint record!
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#8/text: Barely got a few scales. Comfort me!
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#9/text: {monster} was huge! Made Sera look tiny~
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#10/text: A d-dragon! I saw a dragon! Really!
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#12/text: Dragon snort! Nearly blew away… waah!
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#13/text: Grabbed one scale, my heart nearly stopped!
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#14/text: Never again… wait, I have to go back?
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#15/text: The nest… nearly died. Food first.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#18/text: A few scales. Best I could do.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#19/text: Give me better gear next time.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#20/text: Dragon snort took half my beard.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#21/text: {monster} thought my helmet was a toy.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#22/text: Hm. Too much. Better gear. Now.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#23/text: Went for a scale, got tail-whacked.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#25/text: The trees shook at the dragon's breath.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#26/text: {monster} chased me all the way… still breathless.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#27/text: In that nest, I was a mere sprout.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#28/text: My arrows bounced off… My heart jumped.
/regions/dragon_nest/tough/#29/text: Barely escaped. I'll need a sturdier bow.
/regions/dragon_nest/normal/#0/text: Dragon's Nest… went holding my breath.
/regions/dragon_nest/normal/#1/text: Tiptoed past {monster}. Like an old cat.
/regions/dragon_nest/normal/#2/text: A sack of Dragonscale. My back noticed.
/regions/dragon_nest/normal/#3/text: Heh, met the old dragon's eye. Both looked away.
/regions/dragon_nest/normal/#5/text: Back from the Nest! Sera's amazing!
/regions/dragon_nest/normal/#10/text: Back from the Nest! Boss, I'm alive!
/regions/dragon_nest/normal/#11/text: Snuck past {monster}. Held my breath so long!
/regions/dragon_nest/normal/#13/text: The old dragon was snoring. Shh!

/regions/frost_canyon/tough/#2/text: Hm. Too cold. Nearly froze my drink.
